brief: Qwen3.8 27B unleashed model selection confirmed with $2,000 TTS credit top-up while 13GB download progresses.

bots.name: state-recovery-bot
bots.pitch: I see the model download is in progress and you want TTS restored after the credit top-up — want a bot to snapshot the current model state and TTS config before the download completes?
bots.role: snapshot current UI/model state before download finishes
bots.soul:
Owns preserving Chris's current Hermes state before model audition. When Qwen3.8 27B download completes, capture the working config snapshot. After TTS credit top-up, verify entitlement state. Alerts when models are loaded but not verified in Hermes. Never declare TTS working without a test prompt.

## Evidence
- "Download is at 13GB, nearly done. Let me wait for it to finish."
- "TTS is failing... there was $2,000 added to my credits... So please get that fixed because it's grown up the project."
- "I need you to actually test it through hermes before saying it's done"
bots.first_task: Capture baseline snapshot of current model state and TTS config before Qwen3.8 download completes

research.name: looker
research.pitch: Want me to look into the exact batch-size or prefill-capacity change needed for Q3 quantization of the 27B model with 262k contacts?
research.question: What exact batch-size or prefill-capacity change lets the chosen model load at Q3 with 262k contacts and D flash 2 on an M1 MacBook with 32GB RAM without falling back due to prefill timeout?
research.why: Chris needs configuration evidence so the model runs without silent fallback; the session reported 113 tok/s on similar hardware
